core_requests: Home for the shared ransomware helpers (P196 cond 3, P357): move the victim-name and group-alias normalisers, match_claim/report_claims/actor_profile and the 'not listed' wording from v3lum/modules/darkweb_ransomware/ransomlook.py to a core module (e.g. v3lum/core/ransomware.py); ransomware_live, ransomfeed and v3lum/correlations/g09_ransomware.py then import it.

v3lum.core.datasets.register_dataset: date-templated URLs ({today}, {today-30}) so ransomlook_recent_posts can use /api/posts/period/{d1}/{d2} as P196 cond 1 names it (today the static /api/last/30 equivalent).

Dataset manager: licence/terms gate before a download (policy.decide on the dataset's source) and keyed downloads (key header from the key registry, redacted), so ransomware.live recentvictims (noncommercial v2 / licence-gated PRO) can feed watch without bypassing P197 cond 1-2.

v3lum.core.sanitize (A4 second net): a per-source way for sensitive providers to extract attacker-authored data before scrubbing (ransom-note 'content' -> contacts only; IOC keys named 'ip'; hex hashes next to e-mail keys in IOC feeds), so P197 cond 6 ransom-note contacts and IP/hash group IOCs can reach the graph.
v3lum.core.entities: an entity type for messenger IDs such as Tox (P197 cond 6 qTox contacts are counted, not pivoted).
v3lum.core.datasets.DatasetInfo: record the upstream commit of GitHub-hosted datasets (P205 cond 1 'list date/commit kept per match'; today list date = fetch date plus the list SHA-256).

Redact presigned S3 query parameters (X-Amz-Signature, X-Amz-Credential, X-Amz-Security-Token) in cache, logs and evidence, or expose the OFAC SDN 'Digital Currency Address - <ASSET>' remarks parsed by sanctions_lists (P219), so crypto_sanctions_offline can cite SDN entity and programme per hit (P205 cond 5).
Core safe XML helper (P356 cond 1): ransomfeed parses the RSS with an expat stand-in (no DTD/entities); switch when the core helper exists.
P335/P302: group findings by the g09_ransomware_corroborated correlation key (victim + group alias + first date) and score a victim claim once across trackers (P196 cond 5).

Vocabulary/registry rule: only crypto_sanctions_* and sanctions_lists may set the 'sanctions' tag on crypto nodes; the GoPlus owner maps its 'sanctioned' flag to an attribute (P205 cond 6; the rule g09_sanctions_non_authoritative labels it meanwhile).
